No verdict or factual acceptance is asserted.","provider":"Heurist Mesh","rawSha256":"f28bd1f3b05b34087f1a4bcb798f27b30240088a232608f740575f64151fb544","receivedAt":"2026-11-12T10:53:59.523Z","requestId":null,"schemaSha256":"bc52520f096614747186fedb77a2117ac0c7c03e7a8b309be3443d947158d6c4","sourceCapture":"Operator-retrieved bounded excerpts after provider execution; not provider-supplied full source bodies.","sourceCommit":"256420256b995e55543241e9b4e616a95a262699"},"report":"{\"data\":{\"data\":{\"processed_summary\":\"Aave V3 is a decentralized, non-custodial liquidity protocol that enables users to lend and borrow crypto assets through smart contracts across multiple blockchain networks like Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche [1, 3, 5].\\n\\nSupplying assets involves users depositing cryptocurrencies into Aave's liquidity pools to earn interest [5]. Upon supplying, users receive interest-bearing aTokens (e.g., aWETH for WETH), which are ERC-20 tokens whose balance automatically increases over time due to accrued interest [1, 3, 5]. The interest earned by suppliers is not fixed and varies based on the \\\"utilization rate\\\" of the asset in the pool: a higher utilization rate (more borrowed liquidity) leads to increased interest rates to incentivize more supply and borrowing repayments [1, 5]. Users can withdraw their assets and accrued interest by redeeming aTokens, provided there is available unborrowed liquidity [3, 5].\\n\\nCollateralized borrowing requires users to post supplied assets as collateral to access liquidity [3, 5]. All loans on Aave V3 are \\\"overcollateralized,\\\" meaning \\\"the value of the collateral must exceed the borrowed amount\\\" as a safeguard against market volatility [1, 3, 5]. Each collateral asset has a specific \\\"Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio,\\\" which determines \\\"the maximum amount that can be borrowed relative to the collateral\\u2019s value\\\" [4, 5, 6]. For example, a 75% LTV on ETH collateral means a user can borrow up to 75% of the ETH's value [5, 6]. The LTV ratio \\\"evolves with market conditions\\\" [6]. Borrowers can repay their loans, including accrued interest, at any time to unlock their collateral [5].\\n\\nLiquidation risk is managed through a \\\"Health Factor\\\" [1, 3, 6]. This factor is calculated based on the collateral value and the liquidation threshold of the assets, relative to the total borrowed amount [6]. If a user's health factor drops below 1, typically due to falling collateral prices or accrued interest, their position becomes \\\"eligible for liquidation\\\" [1, 3, 5, 6]. At this point, \\\"third-party liquidators can repay a portion of the debt and receive the corresponding collateral, plus a liquidation bonus\\\" [1, 3, 5]. This mechanism ensures the protocol's solvency by maintaining adequate collateralization [1, 5]. The \\\"liquidation threshold\\\" is the specific collateral ratio where a position is deemed undercollateralized and can be liquidated [1, 4, 6].\\n\\nVariable borrowing interest rates are determined algorithmically and adjust dynamically based on the \\\"utilization rate\\\" of each asset pool [1, 3, 4, 5]. As the utilization rate increases, indicating higher borrowing demand and reduced liquidity, interest rates rise to incentivize more supply and moderate further borrowing [1, 4, 5]. Aave V3 uses an interest rate model with \\\"two slopes with an optimal utilization point,\\\" where rates rise faster beyond this optimal point [3].\\n\\n[WARNING] Total Value Locked (TVL) data may be outdated. Aave was reported to have approximately 34 billion USD secured in smart contracts as of July 29, 2025 [1].\\n\\nSources:\\n1. https://www.banqueducanada.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/sap2026-13.pdf\\n2. https://www.aave.org/docs/aave-v3/overview\\n3. https://www.aave.com/docs/aave-v3/concepts/reserve\\n4. https://www.aave.org/help/aave-101/introduction-to-aave\\n5. https://github.com/aave/risk-v3/blob/main/asset-risk/risk-parameters.md\"},\"status\":\"success\"}}","sources":[{"sha256":"46792654bdb5e201dcab3075ed0bc02451bf1e8ae70d7c8ab8e38d96c9d81a8c","url":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haris4587/ProofPilot/256420256b995e55543241e9b4e616a95a262699/evidence/heurist-funded-attempt-2026-11-12/sources/aave-intro.txt"},{"sha256":"64d7d9465f588ee0755ba251dcf55f0afe12d033c0143539924236c61e3a9710","url":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haris4587/ProofPilot/256420256b995e55543241e9b4e616a95a262699/evidence/heurist-funded-attempt-2026-11-12/sources/aave-reserve.txt"},{"sha256":"0ec54618e6a872e1db8ca1546965756cd1ee727ddb3728952a303c436e166c63","url":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haris4587/ProofPilot/256420256b995e55543241e9b4e616a95a262699/evidence/heurist-funded-attempt-2026-11-12/sources/bank.txt"}]}
